      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_power_estimation",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Enable Power Estimation",

      },
      "value": true,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Estimate power consumption when real measurement is not available (AC/DC devices only)",
        "fr": "Estimer la consommation quand la mesure réelle n'est pas disponible (appareils AC/DC seulement)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_natural_light",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Enable Natural Light (Solar Sync)",

      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Automatically adjust color temperature based on time of day",

      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_radio_sensing",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Enable Radio Presence Sensing",
        "fr": "Activer la Détection de Présence Radio"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Infer presence from Zigbee signal fluctuations (BETA)",
        "fr": "Déduit la présence des fluctuations du signal Zigbee (BETA)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "radio_sensitivity",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Radio Presence Sensitivity",
        "fr": "Sensibilité Présence Radio"
      },
      "value": 15,
      "min": 5,
      "max": 50,
      "hint": {
        "en": "LQI variance threshold (higher = less sensitive)",
        "fr": "Seuil de variance LQI (plus haut = moins sensible)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_software_child_lock",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Software Child Lock",
        "fr": "Sécurité Enfant Logicielle"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Prevents manual state changes on the device",
        "fr": "Empêche les changements d'état manuels sur l'appareil"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "auto_off_duration",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Auto-Off Timer (Minutes)",
        "fr": "Minuterie Auto-Off (Minutes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 1440,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Turn off automatically after X minutes (0 = disabled)",
        "fr": "S'éteint après X minutes (0 = désactivé)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_vacation_mode",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Vacation Mode (Presence Sim)",
        "fr": "Mode Vacances (Simulation Présence)"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Randomly toggle device during evenings to simulate presence",
        "fr": "Actionne l'appareil aléatoirement le soir pour simuler une présence"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "emulated_motion_hold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Emulated Motion Hold (Seconds)",
        "fr": "Maintien Mouvement Émulé (Secondes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 3600,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Keep motion 'ON' for X seconds after hardware clears",
        "fr": "Garde le mouvement 'ON' pendant X secondes après le reset matériel"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "double_click_interval",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Double Click Interval (ms)",
        "fr": "Intervalle Double-Clic (ms)"
      },
      "value": 400,
      "min": 100,
      "max": 1000,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Software emulation for single-action buttons",
        "fr": "Émulation logicielle pour boutons à action unique"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "overload_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Overload Protection (Watts)",
        "fr": "Protection Surcharge (Watts)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 4000,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Cut power if consumption exceeds this value (0 = disabled)",
        "fr": "Coupure si la consommation dépasse cette valeur (0 = désactivé)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_night_mode",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Night Mode (Auto-Dim)",
        "fr": "Mode Nuit (Auto-Dim)"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Automatically dim light when turned on at night",
        "fr": "Baisse l'intensité lors de l'allumage nocturne"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "inching_duration",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Inching Duration (Secs)",
        "fr": "Durée Inching (Secondes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 60,
      "step": 0.1,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Automatically turn off after X seconds (Pulse mode)",
        "fr": "S'éteint automatiquement après X secondes (mode Impulsion)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_state_recovery",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Software State Recovery",
        "fr": "Récupération d'État Logicielle"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Restore previous ON/OFF state after power failure",
        "fr": "Restore l'état précédent après une coupure de courant"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_circadian_lighting",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Circadian Lighting (Adaptive CT)",
        "fr": "Éclairage Circadien (CT Adaptatif)"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Automatically adjust color temperature based on time of day",
        "fr": "Ajuste automatiquement la température de couleur au cours de la journée"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_soft_transitions",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Soft transitions (Fade)",
        "fr": "Transitions douces (Fade)"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Enable software-simulated smooth transitions (Lights/Dim)",
        "fr": "Active les transitions douces simulées (Lumières/Variateurs)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "maintenance_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Maintenance Alert Threshold",
        "fr": "Seuil Alerte Maintenance"
      },
      "value": 30,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 100,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Alert if health score drops below this value",
        "fr": "Alerte si le score de santé descend sous cette valeur"
      }
    }
  ],
  "images": {
    "small": "drivers/bulb_rgb/assets/images/small.png",
    "large": "drivers/bulb_rgb/assets/images/large.png",
    "xlarge": "drivers/bulb_rgb/assets/images/xlarge.png"
  },
  "platforms": [
    "local"
  ],
  "connectivity": [
    "zigbee"
  ],
  "pair": [
    {
      "id": "list_devices",
      "template": "list_devices",
      "navigation": {
        "next": "select_driver"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "select_driver",
      "navigation": {
        "next": "add_devices"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "add_devices",
      "template": "add_devices"
    }
  ],
  "capabilitiesOptions": {
    "onoff": {
      "setOnDim": true
    }
  },
  "maintenanceActions": [
    {
      "id": "ota_check",
      "title": {
        "en": "Check Zigbee OTA Update",
        "fr": "Vérifier MàJ OTA",
        "nl": "Controleer op OTA-updates"
      }
    }
  ],
  "flow": {
    "triggers": [],
    "conditions": [],
    "actions": []
  },
  "metadata": {
    "homey": {
      "natural_light": true
    }
  }
}

      }
    },

    {

      },

      "values": [
        {
          "id": "auto",
          "label": {
            "en": "Auto Detect",
            "fr": "Détection Automatique"
          }
        },
        {

          "label": {
            "en": "CR2032",
            "fr": "CR2032 (Pile Bouton 3V)"
          }
        },
        {
          "id": "CR2450",
          "label": {
            "en": "CR2450",
            "fr": "CR2450 (Pile Bouton 3V)"

        {

          "label": {
            "en": "AAA",
            "fr": "AAA"
          }

        {

          "label": {
            "en": "AA",
            "fr": "AA"
          }
        },
        {

          "label": {
            "en": "CR123A",
            "fr": "CR123A"
          }
        }

        "fr": "Sélectionnez le type de batterie manuellement ou utilisez la détection automatique basée sur la tension"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "battery_low_threshold",

      "max": 50,

    {
      "id": "battery_critical_threshold",

        "fr": "Envoyer des notifications de flow pour les événements de batterie"
      }

    {

            "en": "Balanced",
            "fr": "Équilibré"
          }

        {

        "fr": "Équilibre entre réactivité et durée de vie de la batterie"

        "fr": "Estimer la consommation quand la mesure réelle n'est pas disponible (appareils AC/DC seulement)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_natural_light",
      "type": "checkbox",

        "fr": "Activer la Lumière Naturelle (Synchro Solaire)"

      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Automatically adjust color temperature based on time of day",
        "fr": "Ajuste automatiquement la température de couleur au fil de la journée"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_radio_sensing",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Enable Radio Presence Sensing",
        "fr": "Activer la Détection de Présence Radio"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Infer presence from Zigbee signal fluctuations (BETA)",
        "fr": "Déduit la présence des fluctuations du signal Zigbee (BETA)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "radio_sensitivity",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Radio Presence Sensitivity",
        "fr": "Sensibilité Présence Radio"
      },
      "value": 15,
      "min": 5,
      "max": 50,
      "hint": {
        "en": "LQI variance threshold (higher = less sensitive)",
        "fr": "Seuil de variance LQI (plus haut = moins sensible)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_software_child_lock",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Software Child Lock",
        "fr": "Sécurité Enfant Logicielle"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Prevents manual state changes on the device",
        "fr": "Empêche les changements d'état manuels sur l'appareil"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "auto_off_duration",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {

      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 1440,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Turn off automatically after X minutes (0 = disabled)",
        "fr": "S'éteint après X minutes (0 = désactivé)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_vacation_mode",

      "id": "emulated_motion_hold",

    {
      "id": "overload_threshold",
      "type": "number",

      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 4000,
      "hint": {

    {
      "id": "enable_night_mode",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Night Mode (Auto-Dim)",
        "fr": "Mode Nuit (Auto-Dim)"

      "value": false,
      "hint": {

    {
      "id": "inching_duration",

    },
    {
      "id": "battery_critical_threshold",

      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_battery_notifications",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Enable Battery Notifications",
        "fr": "Activer Notifications Batterie"

      "value": true,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Send flow notifications for battery events",
        "fr": "Envoyer des notifications de flow pour les événements de batterie"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "battery_report_interval",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Battery Report Interval",
        "fr": "Intervalle Rapport Batterie (heures)"
      },
      "value": 24,
      "min": 1,
      "max": 168,
      "step": 1,
      "hint": {
        "en": "How often to request battery status updates",
        "fr": "Fréquence de demande des mises à jour d'état de batterie"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "optimization_mode",
      "type": "dropdown",
      "label": {
        "en": "Energy Optimization Mode",
        "fr": "Mode Optimisation Énergétique"
      },
      "value": "balanced",
      "values": [
        {
          "id": "performance",
          "label": {
            "en": "Performance (More responsive)",
            "fr": "Performance (Plus réactif)"
          }
        },
        {
          "id": "balanced",
          "label": {
            "en": "Balanced",
            "fr": "Équilibré"
          }
        },
        {
          "id": "power_saving",
          "label": {
            "en": "Power Saving (Longer battery)",
            "fr": "Économie d'énergie (Batterie plus longue)"
          }
        }
      ],
      "hint": {
        "en": "Balance between responsiveness and battery life",
        "fr": "Équilibre entre réactivité et durée de vie de la batterie"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "show_voltage",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Show Battery Voltage",
        "fr": "Afficher Tension Batterie"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Display raw battery voltage in device settings",
        "fr": "Afficher la tension brute de la batterie dans les paramètres du périphérique"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_power_estimation",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Enable Power Estimation",
        "fr": "Activer Estimation Puissance"
      },
      "value": true,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Estimate power consumption when real measurement is not available (AC/DC devices only)",
        "fr": "Estimer la consommation quand la mesure réelle n'est pas disponible (appareils AC/DC seulement)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "tuya_dp_configuration",
      "type": "label",
      "label": {
        "en": "Tuya Datapoint Configuration",
        "fr": "Configuration Tuya Datapoint"
      },
      "value": "DP1/DP14: SOS (bool)\nDP4/DP15: Battery %\nDP101: Context (bool=SOS, num=battery)"
    },
    {
      "id": "dp_debug_mode",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "DP Debug Mode",
        "fr": "Mode Debug DP"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Log all Tuya DP data for troubleshooting",
        "fr": "Logger toutes les données Tuya DP pour diagnostic"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_time_sync",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Enable Time Sync",
        "fr": "Activer Synchro Heure"
      },
      "value": true,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Sync device time with Homey",
        "fr": "Synchroniser l'heure du device avec Homey"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_radio_sensing",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Enable Radio Presence Sensing",
        "fr": "Activer la Détection de Présence Radio"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Infer presence from Zigbee signal fluctuations (BETA)",
        "fr": "Déduit la présence des fluctuations du signal Zigbee (BETA)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "radio_sensitivity",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Radio Presence Sensitivity",
        "fr": "Sensibilité Présence Radio"
      },
      "value": 15,
      "min": 5,
      "max": 50,
      "hint": {
        "en": "LQI variance threshold (higher = less sensitive)",
        "fr": "Seuil de variance LQI (plus haut = moins sensible)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_software_child_lock",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Software Child Lock",
        "fr": "Sécurité Enfant Logicielle"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Prevents manual state changes on the device",
        "fr": "Empêche les changements d'état manuels sur l'appareil"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "auto_off_duration",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Auto-Off Timer (Minutes)",
        "fr": "Minuterie Auto-Off (Minutes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 1440,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Turn off automatically after X minutes (0 = disabled)",
        "fr": "S'éteint après X minutes (0 = désactivé)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_vacation_mode",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Vacation Mode (Presence Sim)",
        "fr": "Mode Vacances (Simulation Présence)"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Randomly toggle device during evenings to simulate presence",
        "fr": "Actionne l'appareil aléatoirement le soir pour simuler une présence"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "emulated_motion_hold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Emulated Motion Hold (Seconds)",
        "fr": "Maintien Mouvement Émulé (Secondes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 3600,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Keep motion 'ON' for X seconds after hardware clears",
        "fr": "Garde le mouvement 'ON' pendant X secondes après le reset matériel"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "double_click_interval",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Double Click Interval (ms)",
        "fr": "Intervalle Double-Clic (ms)"
      },
      "value": 400,
      "min": 100,
      "max": 1000,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Software emulation for single-action buttons",
        "fr": "Émulation logicielle pour boutons à action unique"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "overload_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Overload Protection (Watts)",
        "fr": "Protection Surcharge (Watts)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 4000,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Cut power if consumption exceeds this value (0 = disabled)",
        "fr": "Coupure si la consommation dépasse cette valeur (0 = désactivé)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "inching_duration",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Inching Duration (Secs)",
        "fr": "Durée Inching (Secondes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 60,
      "step": 0.1,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Automatically turn off after X seconds (Pulse mode)",
        "fr": "S'éteint automatiquement après X secondes (mode Impulsion)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_state_recovery",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Software State Recovery",
        "fr": "Récupération d'État Logicielle"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Restore previous ON/OFF state after power failure",
        "fr": "Restore l'état précédent après une coupure de courant"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_soft_transitions",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Soft transitions (Fade)",
        "fr": "Transitions douces (Fade)"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Enable software-simulated smooth transitions (Lights/Dim)",
        "fr": "Active les transitions douces simulées (Lumières/Variateurs)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "maintenance_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Maintenance Alert Threshold",
        "fr": "Seuil Alerte Maintenance"
      },
      "value": 30,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 100,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Alert if health score drops below this value",
        "fr": "Alerte si le score de santé descend sous cette valeur"
      }
    }

  "images": {

      "id": "emulated_motion_hold",
      "type": "number",

      "id": "double_click_interval",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {

        "fr": "Intervalle Double-Clic (ms)"

      "min": 100,
      "max": 1000,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Software emulation for single-action buttons",
        "fr": "Émulation logicielle pour boutons à action unique"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "overload_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Overload Protection (Watts)",
        "fr": "Protection Surcharge (Watts)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 4000,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Cut power if consumption exceeds this value (0 = disabled)",
        "fr": "Coupure si la consommation dépasse cette valeur (0 = désactivé)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "inching_duration",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Inching Duration (Secs)",
        "fr": "Durée Inching (Secondes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 60,
      "step": 0.1,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Automatically turn off after X seconds (Pulse mode)",

      "label": {
        "en": "Software State Recovery",
        "fr": "Récupération d'État Logicielle"

      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Restore previous ON/OFF state after power failure",
        "fr": "Restore l'état précédent après une coupure de courant"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_soft_transitions",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Soft transitions (Fade)",
        "fr": "Transitions douces (Fade)"

      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Enable software-simulated smooth transitions (Lights/Dim)",
        "fr": "Active les transitions douces simulées (Lumières/Variateurs)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "maintenance_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Maintenance Alert Threshold",
        "fr": "Seuil Alerte Maintenance"
      },
      "value": 30,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 100,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Alert if health score drops below this value",
        "fr": "Alerte si le score de santé descend sous cette valeur"
      }

  },
  "settings": [
    {

    },
    {

        "en": "LQI variance threshold (higher = less sensitive)",
        "fr": "Seuil de variance LQI (plus haut = moins sensible)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_software_child_lock",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Software Child Lock",
        "fr": "Sécurité Enfant Logicielle"
      },

      }

      "max": 1440,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Turn off automatically after X minutes (0 = disabled)",
        "fr": "S'éteint après X minutes (0 = désactivé)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_vacation_mode",

      "label": {
        "en": "Vacation Mode (Presence Sim)",
        "fr": "Mode Vacances (Simulation Présence)"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {

        "fr": "Actionne l'appareil aléatoirement le soir pour simuler une présence"
      }
    },

      "id": "emulated_motion_hold",
      "type": "number",

        "fr": "Maintien Mouvement Émulé (Secondes)"

      "max": 3600,

      }

    },

      "id": "enable_soft_transitions",

        "fr": "Transitions douces (Fade)"

        "fr": "Active les transitions douces simulées (Lumières/Variateurs)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "maintenance_threshold",

      },
      "value": 30,

      "id": "double_click_interval",

      "min": 100,
      "max": 1000,

        "fr": "Émulation logicielle pour boutons à action unique"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "overload_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Overload Protection (Watts)",

      "min": 0,
      "max": 4000,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Cut power if consumption exceeds this value (0 = disabled)",

      }
    },
    {
      "id": "inching_duration",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Inching Duration (Secs)",
        "fr": "Durée Inching (Secondes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 60,
      "step": 0.1,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Automatically turn off after X seconds (Pulse mode)",

    {
      "id": "enable_state_recovery",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Software State Recovery",
        "fr": "Récupération d'État Logicielle"

      "value": false,
      "hint": {

      }
    },
    {

        "fr": "Transitions douces (Fade)"

        "en": "Enable software-simulated smooth transitions (Lights/Dim)",

    },
    {
      "id": "maintenance_threshold",

      "id": "overload_threshold",

      }
    },

      "id": "inching_duration",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Inching Duration (Secs)",
        "fr": "Durée Inching (Secondes)"

      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 60,
      "step": 0.1,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Automatically turn off after X seconds (Pulse mode)",

    },
    {
      "id": "enable_state_recovery",

      "label": {
        "en": "Software State Recovery",
        "fr": "Récupération d'État Logicielle"

      "value": false,
      "hint": {

      }
    },

    {

        "fr": "Empêche les changements d'état manuels sur l'appareil"

    },

        "fr": "Intervalle Double-Clic (ms)"
      },
      "value": 400,
      "min": 100,
      "max": 1000,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Software emulation for single-action buttons",
        "fr": "Émulation logicielle pour boutons à action unique"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "overload_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Overload Protection (Watts)",
        "fr": "Protection Surcharge (Watts)"

      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 4000,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Cut power if consumption exceeds this value (0 = disabled)",
        "fr": "Coupure si la consommation dépasse cette valeur (0 = désactivé)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "inching_duration",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Inching Duration (Secs)",
        "fr": "Durée Inching (Secondes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 60,
      "step": 0.1,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Automatically turn off after X seconds (Pulse mode)",
        "fr": "S'éteint automatiquement après X secondes (mode Impulsion)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_state_recovery",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Software State Recovery",
        "fr": "Récupération d'État Logicielle"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Restore previous ON/OFF state after power failure",
        "fr": "Restore l'état précédent après une coupure de courant"
      }
    },

        "fr": "Active les transitions douces simulées (Lumières/Variateurs)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "maintenance_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Maintenance Alert Threshold",
        "fr": "Seuil Alerte Maintenance"
      },
      "value": 30,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 100,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Alert if health score drops below this value",
        "fr": "Alerte si le score de santé descend sous cette valeur"
      }

        "fr": "Actionne l'appareil aléatoirement le soir pour simuler une présence"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "emulated_motion_hold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Emulated Motion Hold (Seconds)",
        "fr": "Maintien Mouvement Émulé (Secondes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 3600,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Keep motion 'ON' for X seconds after hardware clears",
        "fr": "Garde le mouvement 'ON' pendant X secondes après le reset matériel"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "double_click_interval",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Double Click Interval (ms)",
        "fr": "Intervalle Double-Clic (ms)"
      },
      "value": 400,
      "min": 100,
      "max": 1000,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Software emulation for single-action buttons",
        "fr": "Émulation logicielle pour boutons à action unique"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "overload_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Overload Protection (Watts)",
        "fr": "Protection Surcharge (Watts)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 4000,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Cut power if consumption exceeds this value (0 = disabled)",
        "fr": "Coupure si la consommation dépasse cette valeur (0 = désactivé)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "inching_duration",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Inching Duration (Secs)",
        "fr": "Durée Inching (Secondes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 60,
      "step": 0.1,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Automatically turn off after X seconds (Pulse mode)",
        "fr": "S'éteint automatiquement après X secondes (mode Impulsion)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_state_recovery",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Software State Recovery",
        "fr": "Récupération d'État Logicielle"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Restore previous ON/OFF state after power failure",
        "fr": "Restore l'état précédent après une coupure de courant"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_soft_transitions",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Soft transitions (Fade)",
        "fr": "Transitions douces (Fade)"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Enable software-simulated smooth transitions (Lights/Dim)",
        "fr": "Active les transitions douces simulées (Lumières/Variateurs)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "maintenance_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Maintenance Alert Threshold",
        "fr": "Seuil Alerte Maintenance"
      },
      "value": 30,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 100,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Alert if health score drops below this value",
        "fr": "Alerte si le score de santé descend sous cette valeur"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_tpi_regulation",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Adaptive TPI Regulation",
        "fr": "Régulation TPI Adaptative"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Use advanced software-based heating cycles (more precise)",
        "fr": "Utilise des cycles de chauffe logiciels avancés (plus précis)"
      }
    }
  ]
}
</file>

      "type": "dropdown",
      "label": {

      "values": [

          "id": "auto",
          "label": {

            "fr": "Détection Automatique"
          }
        },
        {
          "id": "CR2032",
          "label": {

            "fr": "CR2032 (Pile Bouton 3V)"
          }
        },
        {
          "id": "CR2450",
          "label": {
            "en": "CR2450",
            "fr": "CR2450 (Pile Bouton 3V)"
          }
        },
        {
          "id": "AAA",
          "label": {
            "en": "AAA",
            "fr": "AAA"
          }
        },
        {
          "id": "AA",
          "label": {
            "en": "AA",
            "fr": "AA"
          }
        },
        {
          "id": "CR123A",
          "label": {
            "en": "CR123A",
            "fr": "CR123A"
          }
        }
      ],
      "hint": {
        "en": "Select battery type manually or use auto-detection based on voltage",
        "fr": "Sélectionnez le type de batterie manuellement ou utilisez la détection automatique basée sur la tension"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "battery_low_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Low Battery Threshold",
        "fr": "Seuil Batterie Faible (%)"
      },
      "value": 20,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 50,
      "step": 5,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Trigger low battery warning when below this percentage",
        "fr": "Déclencher l'alerte batterie faible en dessous de ce pourcentage"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "battery_critical_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Critical Battery Threshold",
        "fr": "Seuil Batterie Critique (%)"
      },
      "value": 10,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 30,
      "step": 5,
      "hint": {

      }

      "hint": {

        "fr": "Envoyer des notifications de flow pour les événements de batterie"
      }
    },

      "label": {

      }
    },
    {
      "id": "optimization_mode",

      "label": {
        "en": "Energy Optimization Mode",
        "fr": "Mode Optimisation Énergétique"
      },
      "value": "balanced",
      "values": [
        {
          "id": "performance",
          "label": {
            "en": "Performance (More responsive)",

          "id": "balanced",
          "label": {
            "en": "Balanced",
            "fr": "Équilibré"
          }
        },
        {
          "id": "power_saving",
          "label": {
            "en": "Power Saving (Longer battery)",
            "fr": "Économie d'énergie (Batterie plus longue)"
          }
        }

      "label": {

      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_radio_sensing",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Enable Radio Presence Sensing",
        "fr": "Activer la Détection de Présence Radio"
      },
      "value": false,

        "fr": "Déduit la présence des fluctuations du signal Zigbee (BETA)"

        "en": "Software Child Lock",

      },

      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_state_recovery",

      "label": {

        "fr": "Active les transitions douces simulées (Lumières/Variateurs)"

    },
    {

      "type": "number",

      "max": 100,

{

        ]
      }

      }

  },
  "maintenanceActions": [
    {
      "id": "ota_check",
      "title": {
        "en": "Check Zigbee OTA Update",
        "fr": "Vérifier MàJ OTA",
        "nl": "Controleer op OTA-updates"
      }
    }
  ],
  "capabilitiesOptions": {
    "button.push": {
      "title": {
        "en": "push"
      }
    }
  },
  "flow": {
    "triggers": [],
    "conditions": [],
    "actions": []
  },
  "settings": [
    {
      "id": "enable_radio_sensing",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Enable Radio Presence Sensing",
        "fr": "Activer la Détection de Présence Radio"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Infer presence from Zigbee signal fluctuations (BETA)",
        "fr": "Déduit la présence des fluctuations du signal Zigbee (BETA)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "radio_sensitivity",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Radio Presence Sensitivity",
        "fr": "Sensibilité Présence Radio"
      },
      "value": 15,
      "min": 5,
      "max": 50,
      "hint": {
        "en": "LQI variance threshold (higher = less sensitive)",
        "fr": "Seuil de variance LQI (plus haut = moins sensible)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_software_child_lock",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Software Child Lock",
        "fr": "Sécurité Enfant Logicielle"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Prevents manual state changes on the device",
        "fr": "Empêche les changements d'état manuels sur l'appareil"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "auto_off_duration",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Auto-Off Timer (Minutes)",
        "fr": "Minuterie Auto-Off (Minutes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 1440,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Turn off automatically after X minutes (0 = disabled)",
        "fr": "S'éteint après X minutes (0 = désactivé)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_vacation_mode",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Vacation Mode (Presence Sim)",
        "fr": "Mode Vacances (Simulation Présence)"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Randomly toggle device during evenings to simulate presence",
        "fr": "Actionne l'appareil aléatoirement le soir pour simuler une présence"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "emulated_motion_hold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Emulated Motion Hold (Seconds)",
        "fr": "Maintien Mouvement Émulé (Secondes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 3600,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Keep motion 'ON' for X seconds after hardware clears",
        "fr": "Garde le mouvement 'ON' pendant X secondes après le reset matériel"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "double_click_interval",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Double Click Interval (ms)",
        "fr": "Intervalle Double-Clic (ms)"
      },
      "value": 400,
      "min": 100,
      "max": 1000,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Software emulation for single-action buttons",
        "fr": "Émulation logicielle pour boutons à action unique"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "overload_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Overload Protection (Watts)",
        "fr": "Protection Surcharge (Watts)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 4000,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Cut power if consumption exceeds this value (0 = disabled)",
        "fr": "Coupure si la consommation dépasse cette valeur (0 = désactivé)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "inching_duration",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Inching Duration (Secs)",
        "fr": "Durée Inching (Secondes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 60,
      "step": 0.1,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Automatically turn off after X seconds (Pulse mode)",
        "fr": "S'éteint automatiquement après X secondes (mode Impulsion)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_state_recovery",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Software State Recovery",
        "fr": "Récupération d'État Logicielle"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Restore previous ON/OFF state after power failure",
        "fr": "Restore l'état précédent après une coupure de courant"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_soft_transitions",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Soft transitions (Fade)",
        "fr": "Transitions douces (Fade)"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Enable software-simulated smooth transitions (Lights/Dim)",
        "fr": "Active les transitions douces simulées (Lumières/Variateurs)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "maintenance_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Maintenance Alert Threshold",
        "fr": "Seuil Alerte Maintenance"
      },
      "value": 30,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 100,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Alert if health score drops below this value",
        "fr": "Alerte si le score de santé descend sous cette valeur"
      }
    }
  ]
}
</file>

      "label": {
        "en": "Operating Mode",
        "fr": "Mode de fonctionnement"
      },
      "hint": {
        "en": "Scene Mode allows single/double/long press. Dimmer Mode only supports single press. Auto tries to detect and switch automatically.",

  ],

  ],
  "maintenanceActions": [

      "id": "ota_check",
      "title": {
        "en": "Check Zigbee OTA Update",
        "fr": "Vérifier MàJ OTA",
        "nl": "Controleer op OTA-updates"
      }
    }
  ],
  "flow": {
    "triggers": [],
    "conditions": [],
    "actions": []
  },
  "settings": [
    {
      "id": "enable_radio_sensing",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Enable Radio Presence Sensing",
        "fr": "Activer la Détection de Présence Radio"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Infer presence from Zigbee signal fluctuations (BETA)",
        "fr": "Déduit la présence des fluctuations du signal Zigbee (BETA)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "radio_sensitivity",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Radio Presence Sensitivity",
        "fr": "Sensibilité Présence Radio"
      },
      "value": 15,
      "min": 5,
      "max": 50,
      "hint": {
        "en": "LQI variance threshold (higher = less sensitive)",
        "fr": "Seuil de variance LQI (plus haut = moins sensible)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_software_child_lock",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Software Child Lock",
        "fr": "Sécurité Enfant Logicielle"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Prevents manual state changes on the device",
        "fr": "Empêche les changements d'état manuels sur l'appareil"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "auto_off_duration",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Auto-Off Timer (Minutes)",
        "fr": "Minuterie Auto-Off (Minutes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 1440,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Turn off automatically after X minutes (0 = disabled)",
        "fr": "S'éteint après X minutes (0 = désactivé)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_vacation_mode",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Vacation Mode (Presence Sim)",
        "fr": "Mode Vacances (Simulation Présence)"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Randomly toggle device during evenings to simulate presence",
        "fr": "Actionne l'appareil aléatoirement le soir pour simuler une présence"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "emulated_motion_hold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Emulated Motion Hold (Seconds)",
        "fr": "Maintien Mouvement Émulé (Secondes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 3600,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Keep motion 'ON' for X seconds after hardware clears",
        "fr": "Garde le mouvement 'ON' pendant X secondes après le reset matériel"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "double_click_interval",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Double Click Interval (ms)",
        "fr": "Intervalle Double-Clic (ms)"
      },
      "value": 400,
      "min": 100,
      "max": 1000,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Software emulation for single-action buttons",
        "fr": "Émulation logicielle pour boutons à action unique"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "overload_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Overload Protection (Watts)",
        "fr": "Protection Surcharge (Watts)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 4000,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Cut power if consumption exceeds this value (0 = disabled)",
        "fr": "Coupure si la consommation dépasse cette valeur (0 = désactivé)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "inching_duration",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Inching Duration (Secs)",
        "fr": "Durée Inching (Secondes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 60,
      "step": 0.1,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Automatically turn off after X seconds (Pulse mode)",
        "fr": "S'éteint automatiquement après X secondes (mode Impulsion)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_state_recovery",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Software State Recovery",
        "fr": "Récupération d'État Logicielle"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Restore previous ON/OFF state after power failure",
        "fr": "Restore l'état précédent après une coupure de courant"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_soft_transitions",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Soft transitions (Fade)",
        "fr": "Transitions douces (Fade)"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Enable software-simulated smooth transitions (Lights/Dim)",
        "fr": "Active les transitions douces simulées (Lumières/Variateurs)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "maintenance_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Maintenance Alert Threshold",
        "fr": "Seuil Alerte Maintenance"
      },
      "value": 30,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 100,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Alert if health score drops below this value",
        "fr": "Alerte si le score de santé descend sous cette valeur"
      }
    }
  ]
}
</file>

        "en": "LQI variance threshold (higher = less sensitive)",
        "fr": "Seuil de variance LQI (plus haut = moins sensible)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_software_child_lock",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Software Child Lock",
        "fr": "Sécurité Enfant Logicielle"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Prevents manual state changes on the device",
        "fr": "Empêche les changements d'état manuels sur l'appareil"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "auto_off_duration",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Auto-Off Timer (Minutes)",
        "fr": "Minuterie Auto-Off (Minutes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 1440,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Turn off automatically after X minutes (0 = disabled)",
        "fr": "S'éteint après X minutes (0 = désactivé)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_vacation_mode",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Vacation Mode (Presence Sim)",
        "fr": "Mode Vacances (Simulation Présence)"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Randomly toggle device during evenings to simulate presence",
        "fr": "Actionne l'appareil aléatoirement le soir pour simuler une présence"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "emulated_motion_hold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Emulated Motion Hold (Seconds)",
        "fr": "Maintien Mouvement Émulé (Secondes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 3600,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Keep motion 'ON' for X seconds after hardware clears",
        "fr": "Garde le mouvement 'ON' pendant X secondes après le reset matériel"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "double_click_interval",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Double Click Interval (ms)",
        "fr": "Intervalle Double-Clic (ms)"
      },
      "value": 400,
      "min": 100,
      "max": 1000,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Software emulation for single-action buttons",
        "fr": "Émulation logicielle pour boutons à action unique"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "overload_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Overload Protection (Watts)",
        "fr": "Protection Surcharge (Watts)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 4000,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Cut power if consumption exceeds this value (0 = disabled)",
        "fr": "Coupure si la consommation dépasse cette valeur (0 = désactivé)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_night_mode",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Night Mode (Auto-Dim)",
        "fr": "Mode Nuit (Auto-Dim)"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Automatically dim light when turned on at night",
        "fr": "Baisse l'intensité lors de l'allumage nocturne"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "inching_duration",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Inching Duration (Secs)",
        "fr": "Durée Inching (Secondes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 60,
      "step": 0.1,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Automatically turn off after X seconds (Pulse mode)",
        "fr": "S'éteint automatiquement après X secondes (mode Impulsion)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_state_recovery",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Software State Recovery",
        "fr": "Récupération d'État Logicielle"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Restore previous ON/OFF state after power failure",
        "fr": "Restore l'état précédent après une coupure de courant"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_circadian_lighting",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Circadian Lighting (Adaptive CT)",
        "fr": "Éclairage Circadien (CT Adaptatif)"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Automatically adjust color temperature based on time of day",
        "fr": "Ajuste automatiquement la température de couleur au cours de la journée"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_soft_transitions",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Soft transitions (Fade)",
        "fr": "Transitions douces (Fade)"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Enable software-simulated smooth transitions (Lights/Dim)",
        "fr": "Active les transitions douces simulées (Lumières/Variateurs)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "maintenance_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Maintenance Alert Threshold",
        "fr": "Seuil Alerte Maintenance"
      },
      "value": 30,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 100,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Alert if health score drops below this value",
        "fr": "Alerte si le score de santé descend sous cette valeur"
      }
    }

  "images": {

    "xlarge": "drivers/led_strip/assets/images/xlarge.png"

        "fr": "Sélectionnez le type de batterie manuellement ou utilisez la détection automatique basée sur la tension"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "battery_low_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Low Battery Threshold",
        "fr": "Seuil Batterie Faible (%)"
      },
      "value": 20,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 50,
      "step": 5,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Trigger low battery warning when below this percentage",
        "fr": "Déclencher l'alerte batterie faible en dessous de ce pourcentage"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "battery_critical_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Critical Battery Threshold",
        "fr": "Seuil Batterie Critique (%)"
      },
      "value": 10,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 30,
      "step": 5,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Trigger critical battery warning when below this percentage",
        "fr": "Déclencher l'alerte batterie critique en dessous de ce pourcentage"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_battery_notifications",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Enable Battery Notifications",
        "fr": "Activer Notifications Batterie"
      },
      "value": true,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Send flow notifications for battery events",
        "fr": "Envoyer des notifications de flow pour les événements de batterie"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "battery_report_interval",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Battery Report Interval",
        "fr": "Intervalle Rapport Batterie (heures)"
      },
      "value": 24,
      "min": 1,
      "max": 168,
      "step": 1,
      "hint": {
        "en": "How often to request battery status updates",
        "fr": "Fréquence de demande des mises à jour d'état de batterie"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "optimization_mode",
      "type": "dropdown",
      "label": {
        "en": "Energy Optimization Mode",
        "fr": "Mode Optimisation Énergétique"
      },
      "value": "balanced",
      "values": [
        {
          "id": "performance",
          "label": {
            "en": "Performance (More responsive)",
            "fr": "Performance (Plus réactif)"
          }
        },
        {
          "id": "balanced",
          "label": {
            "en": "Balanced",
            "fr": "Équilibré"
          }
        },
        {
          "id": "power_saving",
          "label": {
            "en": "Power Saving (Longer battery)",
            "fr": "Économie d'énergie (Batterie plus longue)"
          }
        }
      ],
      "hint": {
        "en": "Balance between responsiveness and battery life",
        "fr": "Équilibre entre réactivité et durée de vie de la batterie"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "show_voltage",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Show Battery Voltage",
        "fr": "Afficher Tension Batterie"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Display raw battery voltage in device settings",
        "fr": "Afficher la tension brute de la batterie dans les paramètres du périphérique"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_power_estimation",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Enable Power Estimation",
        "fr": "Activer Estimation Puissance"
      },
      "value": true,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Estimate power consumption when real measurement is not available (AC/DC devices only)",
        "fr": "Estimer la consommation quand la mesure réelle n'est pas disponible (appareils AC/DC seulement)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_natural_light",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Enable Natural Light (Solar Sync)",
        "fr": "Activer la Lumière Naturelle (Synchro Solaire)"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Automatically adjust color temperature based on time of day",
        "fr": "Ajuste automatiquement la température de couleur au fil de la journée"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_radio_sensing",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Enable Radio Presence Sensing",
        "fr": "Activer la Détection de Présence Radio"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Infer presence from Zigbee signal fluctuations (BETA)",
        "fr": "Déduit la présence des fluctuations du signal Zigbee (BETA)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "radio_sensitivity",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Radio Presence Sensitivity",
        "fr": "Sensibilité Présence Radio"
      },
      "value": 15,
      "min": 5,
      "max": 50,
      "hint": {
        "en": "LQI variance threshold (higher = less sensitive)",
        "fr": "Seuil de variance LQI (plus haut = moins sensible)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_software_child_lock",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Software Child Lock",
        "fr": "Sécurité Enfant Logicielle"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Prevents manual state changes on the device",
        "fr": "Empêche les changements d'état manuels sur l'appareil"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "auto_off_duration",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Auto-Off Timer (Minutes)",
        "fr": "Minuterie Auto-Off (Minutes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 1440,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Turn off automatically after X minutes (0 = disabled)",
        "fr": "S'éteint après X minutes (0 = désactivé)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_vacation_mode",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Vacation Mode (Presence Sim)",
        "fr": "Mode Vacances (Simulation Présence)"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Randomly toggle device during evenings to simulate presence",
        "fr": "Actionne l'appareil aléatoirement le soir pour simuler une présence"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "emulated_motion_hold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Emulated Motion Hold (Seconds)",
        "fr": "Maintien Mouvement Émulé (Secondes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 3600,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Keep motion 'ON' for X seconds after hardware clears",
        "fr": "Garde le mouvement 'ON' pendant X secondes après le reset matériel"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "double_click_interval",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Double Click Interval (ms)",
        "fr": "Intervalle Double-Clic (ms)"
      },
      "value": 400,
      "min": 100,
      "max": 1000,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Software emulation for single-action buttons",
        "fr": "Émulation logicielle pour boutons à action unique"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "overload_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Overload Protection (Watts)",
        "fr": "Protection Surcharge (Watts)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 4000,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Cut power if consumption exceeds this value (0 = disabled)",
        "fr": "Coupure si la consommation dépasse cette valeur (0 = désactivé)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_night_mode",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Night Mode (Auto-Dim)",
        "fr": "Mode Nuit (Auto-Dim)"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Automatically dim light when turned on at night",
        "fr": "Baisse l'intensité lors de l'allumage nocturne"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "inching_duration",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Inching Duration (Secs)",
        "fr": "Durée Inching (Secondes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 60,
      "step": 0.1,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Automatically turn off after X seconds (Pulse mode)",
        "fr": "S'éteint automatiquement après X secondes (mode Impulsion)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_state_recovery",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Software State Recovery",
        "fr": "Récupération d'État Logicielle"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Restore previous ON/OFF state after power failure",
        "fr": "Restore l'état précédent après une coupure de courant"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_circadian_lighting",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Circadian Lighting (Adaptive CT)",
        "fr": "Éclairage Circadien (CT Adaptatif)"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Automatically adjust color temperature based on time of day",
        "fr": "Ajuste automatiquement la température de couleur au cours de la journée"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_soft_transitions",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Soft transitions (Fade)",
        "fr": "Transitions douces (Fade)"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Enable software-simulated smooth transitions (Lights/Dim)",
        "fr": "Active les transitions douces simulées (Lumières/Variateurs)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "maintenance_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Maintenance Alert Threshold",
        "fr": "Seuil Alerte Maintenance"
      },
      "value": 30,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 100,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Alert if health score drops below this value",
        "fr": "Alerte si le score de santé descend sous cette valeur"
      }
    }
  ],
  "images": {
    "small": "drivers/bulb_rgb/assets/images/small.png",
    "large": "drivers/bulb_rgb/assets/images/large.png",
    "xlarge": "drivers/bulb_rgb/assets/images/xlarge.png"
  },
  "platforms": [
    "local"
  ],
  "connectivity": [
    "zigbee"
  ],
  "pair": [
    {
      "id": "list_devices",

        "next": "select_driver"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "select_driver",
      "navigation": {
        "next": "add_devices"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "add_devices",
      "template": "add_devices"
    }
  ],
  "capabilitiesOptions": {
    "onoff": {
      "setOnDim": true
    }
  },
  "maintenanceActions": [
    {
      "id": "ota_check",
      "title": {
        "en": "Check Zigbee OTA Update",
        "fr": "Vérifier MàJ OTA",
        "nl": "Controleer op OTA-updates"
      }
    }
  ],
  "flow": {
    "triggers": [],
    "conditions": [],
    "actions": []
  },
  "metadata": {
    "homey": {
      "natural_light": true
    }
  }
}

      "label": {

        "fr": "Récupération d'État Logicielle"

{

  "settings": [
    {
      "type": "group",

          "min": 0,
          "max": 9,
          "step": 1,
          "hint": {
            "en": "Detection sensitivity (0=lowest, 9=highest). Higher values detect smaller movements.",
            "fr": "Sensibilité de détection (0=min, 9=max). Valeurs élevées détectent les petits mouvements."
          }
        },
        {
          "id": "minimum_range",
          "type": "number",
          "label": {
            "en": "Minimum Range (m)",
            "fr": "Distance Minimum (m)"

          "value": 0,
          "min": 0,
          "max": 9.5,
          "step": 0.5,
          "hint": {
            "en": "Minimum detection distance in meters. Objects closer will be ignored.",
            "fr": "Distance minimale de détection en mètres. Objets plus proches seront ignorés."
          }
        },
        {
          "id": "maximum_range",
          "type": "number",
          "label": {
            "en": "Maximum Range (m)",
            "fr": "Distance Maximum (m)"
          },
          "value": 6,
          "min": 0.5,
          "max": 9.5,
          "step": 0.5,
          "hint": {
            "en": "Maximum detection distance in meters (up to 9.5m for most sensors).",
            "fr": "Distance maximale de détection en mètres (jusqu'à 9.5m pour la plupart)."
          }
        },
        {
          "id": "detection_delay",
          "type": "number",
          "label": {
            "en": "Detection Delay (s)",
            "fr": "Délai de Détection (s)"
          },
          "value": 0,
          "min": 0,
          "max": 10,
          "step": 0.5,

            "en": "Delay before reporting presence (0=instant). Helps avoid false positives.",
            "fr": "Délai avant de signaler une présence (0=instantané). Évite les faux positifs."
          }
        },
        {
          "id": "fading_time",
          "type": "number",
          "label": {
            "en": "Absence Delay / Fading Time (s)",

          "value": 60,

          "max": 1500,
          "step": 5,

            "en": "Time before clearing presence after no movement detected. Like FP300 absence delay.",

          }
        }

          }

      "id": "overload_threshold",

    },

      "id": "inching_duration",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Inching Duration (Secs)",
        "fr": "Durée Inching (Secondes)"

      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 60,
      "step": 0.1,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Automatically turn off after X seconds (Pulse mode)",

    },
    {
      "id": "enable_state_recovery",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Software State Recovery",
        "fr": "Récupération d'État Logicielle"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Restore previous ON/OFF state after power failure",
        "fr": "Restore l'état précédent après une coupure de courant"

    },

    {

  "connectivity": [
    "zigbee"
  ],
  "capabilitiesOptions": {
    "onoff": {
      "title": {
        "en": "Radiator Power",
        "fr": "Alimentation Radiateur"
      },
      "preventInsights": false
    },
    "target_temperature": {
      "title": {
        "en": "Target Temperature",
        "fr": "Température Cible"
      },
      "min": 5,
      "max": 30,
      "step": 0.5,
      "units": {
        "en": "°C"
      }
    },
    "thermostat_mode": {
      "title": {
        "en": "Heating Mode",
        "fr": "Mode Chauffage"
      },
      "preventInsights": false
    }
  },
  "energy": {
    "approximation": {
      "usageConstant": 1500
    }
  },
  "flow": {
    "triggers": [
      {
        "id": "radiator_controller_radiator_mode_changed",
        "title": {
          "en": "Heating mode changed",
          "fr": "Mode chauffage changé"
        },
        "tokens": [
          {
            "name": "mode",
            "type": "string",
            "title": {
              "en": "Mode"
            },
            "example": "confort"
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "radiator_controller_pilot_signal_sent",
        "title": {
          "en": "Pilot wire signal sent",
          "fr": "Signal fil pilote envoyé"
        },
        "tokens": [
          {
            "name": "signal_type",
            "type": "string",
            "title": {
              "en": "Signal Type"
            },
            "example": "confort"
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "conditions": [
      {
        "id": "radiator_controller_radiator_is_heating",
        "title": {
          "en": "Radiator !{{is|isn't}} heating",
          "fr": "Radiateur !{{chauffe|ne chauffe pas}}"
        }
      },
      {
        "id": "radiator_controller_heating_mode_is",
        "title": {
          "en": "Heating mode !{{is|isn't}} [[mode]]",
          "fr": "Mode chauffage !{{est|n'est pas}} [[mode]]"
        },
        "args": [
          {
            "type": "dropdown",
            "name": "mode",
            "values": [
              {
                "id": "confort",
                "title": {
                  "en": "Confort"
                }
              },
              {
                "id": "eco",
                "title": {
                  "en": "Éco"
                }
              },
              {
                "id": "anti_freeze",
                "title": {
                  "en": "Hors-Gel"
                }
              },
              {
                "id": "off",
                "title": {
                  "en": "Arrêt"
                }
              }
            ]
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "actions": [
      {
        "id": "radiator_controller_set_heating_mode",
        "title": {
          "en": "Set heating mode to [[mode]]",
          "fr": "Régler mode chauffage sur [[mode]]"
        },
        "args": [
          {
            "type": "dropdown",
            "name": "mode",
            "values": [
              {
                "id": "confort",
                "title": {
                  "en": " Confort"
                }
              },
              {
                "id": "eco",
                "title": {
                  "en": " Éco"
                }
              },
              {
                "id": "confort_minus_1",
                "title": {
                  "en": " Confort -1°C"
                }
              },
              {
                "id": "confort_minus_2",
                "title": {
                  "en": " Confort -2°C"
                }
              },
              {
                "id": "anti_freeze",
                "title": {
                  "en": " Hors-Gel"
                }
              },
              {
                "id": "off",
                "title": {
                  "en": " Arrêt"
                }
              }
            ]
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "radiator_controller_send_pilot_signal",
        "title": {
          "en": "Send pilot wire signal [[signal]]",
          "fr": "Envoyer signal fil pilote [[signal]]"
        },
        "args": [
          {
            "type": "dropdown",
            "name": "signal",
            "values": [
              {
                "id": "confort",
                "title": {
                  "en": "Confort (0V)"
                }
              },
              {
                "id": "eco",
                "title": {
                  "en": "Éco (230V neg)"
                }
              },
              {
                "id": "anti_freeze",
                "title": {
                  "en": "Hors-Gel (230V pos)"
                }
              },
              {
                "id": "off",
                "title": {
                  "en": "Arrêt (230V alt)"
                }
              }
            ]
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "radiator_controller_set_temperature_offset",
        "title": {
          "en": "Set temperature offset",
          "nl": "Temperatuur offset instellen",
          "fr": "Définir offset température",
          "de": "Temperatur-Offset einstellen"
        },
        "titleFormatted": {
          "en": "Set temperature offset to [[offset]]°C",
          "nl": "Stel temperatuur offset in op [[offset]]°C",
          "fr": "Définir offset température à [[offset]]°C"
        },
        "hint": {
          "en": "Adjust the temperature reading by adding an offset value",
          "nl": "Pas de temperatuurmeting aan door een offset toe te voegen"
        },
        "args": [
          {
            "name": "offset",
            "type": "range",
            "min": -5,
            "max": 5,
            "step": 0.5,
            "label": "°C"
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  },
  "pair": [
    {
      "id": "list_devices",
      "template": "list_devices",
      "navigation": {
        "next": "radiator_setup"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "radiator_setup",
      "template": "template_radiator_setup"
    },
    {
      "id": "add_devices",
      "template": "add_devices"
    }
  ],
  "maintenanceActions": [
    {
      "id": "ota_check",
      "title": {
        "en": "Check Zigbee OTA Update",
        "fr": "Vérifier MàJ OTA",
        "nl": "Controleer op OTA-updates"
      }
    }
  ]
}
</file>

<file path="drivers/radiator_valve_zigbee/driver.compose.json">
{
  "name": {
    "en": "Radiator Valve (TRV) Zigbee",

    ],

        ]
      }
    },

      "_tyst11_2ekuz3dz",
      "_tyst11_kly8gjlz",
      "_tze200_bhd_5kn9"
    ]
  },
  "images": {
    "small": "drivers/radiator_valve_zigbee/assets/images/small.png",
    "large": "drivers/radiator_valve_zigbee/assets/images/large.png",
    "xlarge": "drivers/radiator_valve_zigbee/assets/images/xlarge.png"
  },

    "batteries": [
      "CR2450"
    ],
    "mains": true
  },
  "maintenanceActions": [
    {
      "id": "ota_check",
      "title": {
        "en": "Check Zigbee OTA Update",
        "fr": "Vérifier MàJ OTA",
        "nl": "Controleer op OTA-updates"
      }
    }
  ],
  "flow": {
    "triggers": [],
    "conditions": [],
    "actions": []
  },
  "settings": [
    {
      "id": "enable_radio_sensing",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Enable Radio Presence Sensing",
        "fr": "Activer la Détection de Présence Radio"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Infer presence from Zigbee signal fluctuations (BETA)",
        "fr": "Déduit la présence des fluctuations du signal Zigbee (BETA)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "radio_sensitivity",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Radio Presence Sensitivity",
        "fr": "Sensibilité Présence Radio"
      },
      "value": 15,
      "min": 5,
      "max": 50,
      "hint": {
        "en": "LQI variance threshold (higher = less sensitive)",
        "fr": "Seuil de variance LQI (plus haut = moins sensible)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_software_child_lock",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Software Child Lock",
        "fr": "Sécurité Enfant Logicielle"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Prevents manual state changes on the device",
        "fr": "Empêche les changements d'état manuels sur l'appareil"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "auto_off_duration",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Auto-Off Timer (Minutes)",
        "fr": "Minuterie Auto-Off (Minutes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 1440,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Turn off automatically after X minutes (0 = disabled)",
        "fr": "S'éteint après X minutes (0 = désactivé)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_vacation_mode",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Vacation Mode (Presence Sim)",
        "fr": "Mode Vacances (Simulation Présence)"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Randomly toggle device during evenings to simulate presence",
        "fr": "Actionne l'appareil aléatoirement le soir pour simuler une présence"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "emulated_motion_hold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Emulated Motion Hold (Seconds)",
        "fr": "Maintien Mouvement Émulé (Secondes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 3600,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Keep motion 'ON' for X seconds after hardware clears",
        "fr": "Garde le mouvement 'ON' pendant X secondes après le reset matériel"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "double_click_interval",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Double Click Interval (ms)",
        "fr": "Intervalle Double-Clic (ms)"
      },
      "value": 400,
      "min": 100,
      "max": 1000,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Software emulation for single-action buttons",
        "fr": "Émulation logicielle pour boutons à action unique"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "overload_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Overload Protection (Watts)",
        "fr": "Protection Surcharge (Watts)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 4000,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Cut power if consumption exceeds this value (0 = disabled)",
        "fr": "Coupure si la consommation dépasse cette valeur (0 = désactivé)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "inching_duration",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Inching Duration (Secs)",
        "fr": "Durée Inching (Secondes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 60,
      "step": 0.1,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Automatically turn off after X seconds (Pulse mode)",
        "fr": "S'éteint automatiquement après X secondes (mode Impulsion)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_state_recovery",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Software State Recovery",
        "fr": "Récupération d'État Logicielle"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Restore previous ON/OFF state after power failure",
        "fr": "Restore l'état précédent après une coupure de courant"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_soft_transitions",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Soft transitions (Fade)",
        "fr": "Transitions douces (Fade)"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Enable software-simulated smooth transitions (Lights/Dim)",
        "fr": "Active les transitions douces simulées (Lumières/Variateurs)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "maintenance_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Maintenance Alert Threshold",
        "fr": "Seuil Alerte Maintenance"
      },
      "value": 30,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 100,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Alert if health score drops below this value",
        "fr": "Alerte si le score de santé descend sous cette valeur"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_tpi_regulation",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Adaptive TPI Regulation",
        "fr": "Régulation TPI Adaptative"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Use advanced software-based heating cycles (more precise)",
        "fr": "Utilise des cycles de chauffe logiciels avancés (plus précis)"
      }
    }
  ]
}
</file>

<file path="drivers/remote_button_emergency_sos_hybrid/driver.compose.json">
{
  "id": "smart_remote_4_buttons",
  "name": {
    "en": "Remote Button Emergency Sos",
    "nl": "Afstandsbediening Noodknop Sos",
    "fr": "Bouton d'urgence à distance Sos",
    "de": "Fernbedienung Notfallknopf Sos",
    "es": "Botón de Emergencia Remoto Sos"
  },
  "class": "remote",
  "platforms": [
    "local"
  ],
  "connectivity": [
    "zigbee"
  ],
  "capabilities": [
    "button.1",
    "button.2",
    "button.3",
    "button.4",
    "measure_battery",
    "alarm_generic",
    "measure_radio_stability",
    "measure_maintenance_score"
  ],
  "images": {
    "large": "drivers/smart_remote_4_buttons/assets/images/large.png",
    "small": "drivers/smart_remote_4_buttons/assets/images/small.png",
    "xlarge": "drivers/smart_remote_4_buttons/assets/images/xlarge.png"
  },
  "energy": {
    "batteries": [
      "CR2450"
    ],
    "mains": true
  },
  "zigbee": {
    "manufacturerName": [
      "_tyzb01_qm6djpta"
    ],
    "productId": [],
    "endpoints": {
      "1": {
        "clusters": [
          0,
          1,
          1280,
          1281
        ]
      }
    },
    "learnmode": {
      "image": "{{driverAssetsPath}}/icon.svg",
      "instruction": {
        "en": "Push a pin gently into the reset hole on the backside of the unit for aprox 10 seconds until the led on the front blinks rapidly."
      }
    }
  },
  "settings": [
    {
      "id": "button_mode",
      "type": "dropdown",
      "label": {
        "en": "Operating Mode",
        "fr": "Mode de fonctionnement"
      },
      "hint": {
        "en": "Scene Mode allows single/double/long press. Dimmer Mode only supports single press. Auto tries to detect and switch automatically.",
        "fr": "Le mode Scène permet les appuis simples/doubles/longs. Le mode Variateur ne supporte que l'appui simple. Auto tente de détecter et basculer automatiquement."
      },
      "value": "auto",
      "values": [
        {
          "id": "auto",
          "label": {
            "en": "Auto-Detect",
            "fr": "Détection Auto"
          }
        },
        {
          "id": "scene",
          "label": {
            "en": "Scene Mode (Multi-press)",
            "fr": "Mode Scène (Multi-clics)"
          }
        },
        {
          "id": "dimmer",
          "label": {
            "en": "Dimmer Mode",
            "fr": "Mode Variateur"
          }
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_radio_sensing",
      "type": "checkbox",
