        "fr": "Activer la Détection de Présence Radio"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Infer presence from Zigbee signal fluctuations (BETA)",
        "fr": "Déduit la présence des fluctuations du signal Zigbee (BETA)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "radio_sensitivity",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Radio Presence Sensitivity",
        "fr": "Sensibilité Présence Radio"
      },
      "value": 15,
      "min": 5,
      "max": 50,
      "hint": {
        "en": "LQI variance threshold (higher = less sensitive)",
        "fr": "Seuil de variance LQI (plus haut = moins sensible)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_software_child_lock",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Software Child Lock",
        "fr": "Sécurité Enfant Logicielle"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Prevents manual state changes on the device",
        "fr": "Empêche les changements d'état manuels sur l'appareil"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "auto_off_duration",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Auto-Off Timer (Minutes)",
        "fr": "Minuterie Auto-Off (Minutes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 1440,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Turn off automatically after X minutes (0 = disabled)",
        "fr": "S'éteint après X minutes (0 = désactivé)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_vacation_mode",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Vacation Mode (Presence Sim)",
        "fr": "Mode Vacances (Simulation Présence)"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Randomly toggle device during evenings to simulate presence",
        "fr": "Actionne l'appareil aléatoirement le soir pour simuler une présence"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "emulated_motion_hold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Emulated Motion Hold (Seconds)",
        "fr": "Maintien Mouvement Émulé (Secondes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 3600,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Keep motion 'ON' for X seconds after hardware clears",
        "fr": "Garde le mouvement 'ON' pendant X secondes après le reset matériel"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "double_click_interval",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Double Click Interval (ms)",
        "fr": "Intervalle Double-Clic (ms)"
      },
      "value": 400,
      "min": 100,
      "max": 1000,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Software emulation for single-action buttons",
        "fr": "Émulation logicielle pour boutons à action unique"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "overload_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Overload Protection (Watts)",
        "fr": "Protection Surcharge (Watts)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 4000,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Cut power if consumption exceeds this value (0 = disabled)",
        "fr": "Coupure si la consommation dépasse cette valeur (0 = désactivé)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "inching_duration",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Inching Duration (Secs)",
        "fr": "Durée Inching (Secondes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 60,
      "step": 0.1,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Automatically turn off after X seconds (Pulse mode)",
        "fr": "S'éteint automatiquement après X secondes (mode Impulsion)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_state_recovery",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Software State Recovery",
        "fr": "Récupération d'État Logicielle"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Restore previous ON/OFF state after power failure",
        "fr": "Restore l'état précédent après une coupure de courant"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_soft_transitions",

      "label": {
        "en": "Soft transitions (Fade)",
        "fr": "Transitions douces (Fade)"
      },
      "value": false,

        "en": "Enable software-simulated smooth transitions (Lights/Dim)",
        "fr": "Active les transitions douces simulées (Lumières/Variateurs)"
      }
    },
    {

      "type": "number",

        "en": "Maintenance Alert Threshold",
        "fr": "Seuil Alerte Maintenance"
      },
      "value": 30,

<file path="drivers/remote_dimmer/driver.compose.json">
{
  "name": {
    "en": "Remote Control Dimmer (Lidl/Tuya)",
    "fr": "Télécommande Variateur (Lidl/Tuya)",

  },
  "class": "remote",
  "connectivity": [
    "zigbee"
  ],
  "capabilities": [
    "measure_battery",
    "measure_radio_stability",
    "measure_maintenance_score"
  ],
  "energy": {
    "batteries": [
      "CR2450"
    ],
    "mains": true
  },
  "zigbee": {
    "manufacturerName": [
      "_tyzb01_bngwdjsr"
    ],
    "productId": [
      "TS1001",
      "ts1001"
    ],
    "endpoints": {
      "1": {
        "clusters": [
          0,
          1,
          3,
          4,
          4096
        ]
      }
    },
    "learnmode": {
      "image": "/drivers/remote_dimmer/assets/learnmode.svg",
      "instruction": {
        "en": "Press and hold the pairing button for 5 seconds until the LED flashes rapidly.",
        "fr": "Appuyez et maintenez le bouton d'appairage pendant 5 secondes jusqu'au clignotement rapide de la LED.",
        "nl": "Houd de koppelknop 5 seconden ingedrukt tot de LED snel knippert.",
        "de": "Halten Sie die Kopplungstaste 5 Sekunden lang gedrückt, bis die LED schnell blinkt."
      }
    }
  },
  "images": {
    "large": "drivers/remote_dimmer/assets/images/large.png",
    "small": "drivers/remote_dimmer/assets/images/small.png",
    "xlarge": "drivers/remote_dimmer/assets/images/xlarge.png"
  },
  "maintenanceActions": [
    {
      "id": "ota_check",
      "title": {
        "en": "Check Zigbee OTA Update",
        "fr": "Vérifier MàJ OTA",
        "nl": "Controleer op OTA-updates"
      }
    }
  ],
  "flow": {
    "triggers": [],
    "conditions": [],
    "actions": []
  },
  "settings": [
    {
      "id": "enable_radio_sensing",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Enable Radio Presence Sensing",
        "fr": "Activer la Détection de Présence Radio"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Infer presence from Zigbee signal fluctuations (BETA)",
        "fr": "Déduit la présence des fluctuations du signal Zigbee (BETA)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "radio_sensitivity",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Radio Presence Sensitivity",
        "fr": "Sensibilité Présence Radio"
      },
      "value": 15,
      "min": 5,
      "max": 50,
      "hint": {
        "en": "LQI variance threshold (higher = less sensitive)",
        "fr": "Seuil de variance LQI (plus haut = moins sensible)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_software_child_lock",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Software Child Lock",
        "fr": "Sécurité Enfant Logicielle"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Prevents manual state changes on the device",
        "fr": "Empêche les changements d'état manuels sur l'appareil"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "auto_off_duration",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Auto-Off Timer (Minutes)",
        "fr": "Minuterie Auto-Off (Minutes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 1440,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Turn off automatically after X minutes (0 = disabled)",
        "fr": "S'éteint après X minutes (0 = désactivé)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_vacation_mode",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Vacation Mode (Presence Sim)",
        "fr": "Mode Vacances (Simulation Présence)"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Randomly toggle device during evenings to simulate presence",
        "fr": "Actionne l'appareil aléatoirement le soir pour simuler une présence"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "emulated_motion_hold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Emulated Motion Hold (Seconds)",
        "fr": "Maintien Mouvement Émulé (Secondes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 3600,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Keep motion 'ON' for X seconds after hardware clears",
        "fr": "Garde le mouvement 'ON' pendant X secondes après le reset matériel"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "double_click_interval",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Double Click Interval (ms)",
        "fr": "Intervalle Double-Clic (ms)"
      },
      "value": 400,
      "min": 100,
      "max": 1000,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Software emulation for single-action buttons",
        "fr": "Émulation logicielle pour boutons à action unique"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "inching_duration",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Inching Duration (Secs)",
        "fr": "Durée Inching (Secondes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 60,
      "step": 0.1,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Automatically turn off after X seconds (Pulse mode)",
        "fr": "S'éteint automatiquement après X secondes (mode Impulsion)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_state_recovery",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Software State Recovery",
        "fr": "Récupération d'État Logicielle"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Restore previous ON/OFF state after power failure",
        "fr": "Restore l'état précédent après une coupure de courant"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "overload_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Overload Protection (Watts)",
        "fr": "Protection Surcharge (Watts)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 4000,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Cut power if consumption exceeds this value (0 = disabled)",
        "fr": "Coupure si la consommation dépasse cette valeur (0 = désactivé)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_soft_transitions",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Soft transitions (Fade)",
        "fr": "Transitions douces (Fade)"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Enable software-simulated smooth transitions (Lights/Dim)",
        "fr": "Active les transitions douces simulées (Lumières/Variateurs)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "maintenance_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Maintenance Alert Threshold",
        "fr": "Seuil Alerte Maintenance"
      },
      "value": 30,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 100,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Alert if health score drops below this value",
        "fr": "Alerte si le score de santé descend sous cette valeur"
      }
    }
  ]
}
</file>

      "min": 0,

        "fr": "Coupure si la consommation dépasse cette valeur (0 = désactivé)"

    },
    {
      "id": "inching_duration",

      }
    },

{

        "fr": "Appuyez et maintenez le bouton d'appairage pendant 5 secondes jusqu'à ce que la LED clignote."

        "nl": "PIR Gevoeligheid",

      },
      "value": "1",
      "values": [

          "id": "0",

            "fr": "Haute",

            "de": "Hoch"
          }

        "fr": "Durée Maintien PIR",

      },
      "value": "0",
      "values": [
        {
          "id": "0",
          "label": {
            "en": "10 seconds",
            "fr": "10 secondes"
          }
        },
        {
          "id": "1",
          "label": {
            "en": "30 seconds",
            "fr": "30 secondes"
          }
        },
        {
          "id": "2",
          "label": {
            "en": "60 seconds",
            "fr": "60 secondes"
          }
        },
        {
          "id": "3",
          "label": {
            "en": "120 seconds",
            "fr": "120 secondes"
          }

        "fr": "Durée de maintien de la présence après le dernier mouvement (capteurs ZG-204ZL, TS0601 PIR). Nécessite le réveil du périphérique."
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "motion_holdoff",
      "type": "number",

        "en": "Motion Holdoff (seconds)",
        "fr": "Délai Mouvement (secondes)",

        "de": "Bewegung Holdoff (Sekunden)"
      },
      "value": 60,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 300,
      "step": 10,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Delay before triggering 'no motion' to prevent false triggers in occupied rooms. Set to 0 to disable.",
        "fr": "Délai avant de déclencher 'pas de mouvement' pour éviter les faux déclenchements dans les pièces occupées. Définir à 0 pour désactiver.",

          }

          "label": {
            "en": "DC Powered",
            "fr": "Alimentation DC"
          }
        },
        {
          "id": "battery",
          "label": {
            "en": "Battery Powered",
            "fr": "Sur Batterie"
          }
        }
      ],

      "value": 0,

        "fr": "Garde le mouvement 'ON' pendant X secondes après le reset matériel"

        "fr": "Intervalle Double-Clic (ms)"

      "min": 100,
      "max": 1000,

        "fr": "Émulation logicielle pour boutons à action unique"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "overload_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Overload Protection (Watts)",
        "fr": "Protection Surcharge (Watts)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 4000,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Cut power if consumption exceeds this value (0 = disabled)",
        "fr": "Coupure si la consommation dépasse cette valeur (0 = désactivé)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "inching_duration",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Inching Duration (Secs)",
        "fr": "Durée Inching (Secondes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 60,
      "step": 0.1,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Automatically turn off after X seconds (Pulse mode)",
        "fr": "S'éteint automatiquement après X secondes (mode Impulsion)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_state_recovery",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Software State Recovery",
        "fr": "Récupération d'État Logicielle"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Restore previous ON/OFF state after power failure",
        "fr": "Restore l'état précédent après une coupure de courant"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_soft_transitions",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Soft transitions (Fade)",
        "fr": "Transitions douces (Fade)"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Enable software-simulated smooth transitions (Lights/Dim)",
        "fr": "Active les transitions douces simulées (Lumières/Variateurs)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "maintenance_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Maintenance Alert Threshold",
        "fr": "Seuil Alerte Maintenance"
      },
      "value": 30,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 100,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Alert if health score drops below this value",
        "fr": "Alerte si le score de santé descend sous cette valeur"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_tpi_regulation",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Adaptive TPI Regulation",
        "fr": "Régulation TPI Adaptative"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Use advanced software-based heating cycles (more precise)",
        "fr": "Utilise des cycles de chauffe logiciels avancés (plus précis)"
      }
    }

  "images": {
    "small": "drivers/presence_sensor_radar/assets/images/small.png",
    "large": "drivers/presence_sensor_radar/assets/images/large.png",
    "xlarge": "drivers/presence_sensor_radar/assets/images/xlarge.png"
  },
  "platforms": [
    "local"
  ],
  "connectivity": [
    "zigbee"
  ],
  "energy": {
    "batteries": [
      "CR2450"
    ],
    "approximation": {
      "usageConstant": 0.5
    },
    "mains": true
  },
  "pair": [
    {
      "id": "list_devices",
      "template": "list_devices",
      "navigation": {
        "next": "select_driver"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "select_driver",
      "navigation": {
        "next": "add_devices"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "add_devices",
      "template": "add_devices"
    }
  ],
  "maintenanceActions": [
    {
      "id": "ota_check",
      "title": {
        "en": "Check Zigbee OTA Update",
        "fr": "Vérifier MàJ OTA",
        "nl": "Controleer op OTA-updates"
      }
    }
  ],
  "flow": {
    "triggers": [],
    "conditions": [],
    "actions": []
  }
}

{
  "name": {
    "en": "Sensor Climate Temphumidsensor",
    "nl": "Sensor Klimaat TempHumiSensor",

    "es": "Sensor Clima TempHumiSensor"
  },
  "class": "sensor",
  "capabilities": [
    "measure_temperature",
    "measure_humidity",
    "measure_battery",
    "measure_radio_stability",
    "measure_maintenance_score"

    "batteries": [
      "CR2450"
    ],
    "mains": true
  },
  "subDevices": [],

    "measure_temperature.probe": {
      "title": {
        "en": "Probe Temperature",
        "fr": "Température Sonde",
        "nl": "Sonde Temperatuur",
        "de": "Sondentemperatur"
      }
    }
  },
  "zigbee": {
    "manufacturerName": [
      "hobeian",
      "tuyatec-1g3tawnp",
      "tuyatec-1uxx9cci",
      "tuyatec-abkehqus",
      "tuyatec-bfq2i2sy",
      "tuyatec-g3gl6cgy",
      "tuyatec-gqhxixyk",
      "tuyatec-haoiuwzy",
      "tuyatec-ojmxeikg",
      "tuyatec-ojmxeikq",
      "tuyatec-prhs1rsd",
      "tuyatec-qun7vq14",
      "tuyatec-riuj5xzs",
      "tuyatec-v3uxbuxy",
      "tuyatec-vmgh3fxd",
      "tuyatec-yg5dcbfu",
      "_tz3000_i8jfiezr"
    ],
    "productId": [
      "CK-TLSR8656-SS5-01(7014)",
      "ZG-227Z",
      "ck-tlsr8656-ss5-01(7014)",
      "zg-227z"
    ],
    "endpoints": {
      "1": {
        "clusters": [
          0,
          61184
        ]
      }
    }
  },
  "settings": [
    {
      "type": "group",
      "label": {
        "en": " Calibration (v5.5.28)",
        "fr": " Calibration (v5.5.28)"
      },
      "children": [
        {
          "id": "temperature_calibration",
          "type": "number",
          "label": {
            "en": "Temperature Offset (°C)",
            "fr": "Décalage Température (°C)"
          },
          "value": 0,
          "min": -10,
          "max": 10,
          "step": 0.1,
          "hint": {
            "en": "Add or subtract from temperature reading. Use positive value if sensor reads too low.",
            "fr": "Ajouter ou soustraire de la température lue. Valeur positive si capteur lit trop bas."
          }
        },
        {
          "id": "humidity_calibration",
          "type": "number",
          "label": {
            "en": "Humidity Offset (%)",
            "fr": "Décalage Humidité (%)"
          },
          "value": 0,
          "min": -20,
          "max": 20,
          "step": 1,
          "hint": {
            "en": "Add or subtract from humidity reading. Use positive value if sensor reads too low.",
            "fr": "Ajouter ou soustraire de l'humidité lue. Valeur positive si capteur lit trop bas."
          }
        },
        {
          "id": "sensor_precision",
          "type": "dropdown",
          "label": {
            "en": "Decimal Precision",
            "fr": "Précision"
          },
          "value": "1",
          "hint": {
            "en": "Decimals for temp/humidity"
          },
          "values": [
            {
              "id": "1",
              "label": {
                "en": "1 decimal (20.5°C)"
              }
            },
            {
              "id": "2",
              "label": {
                "en": "2 decimals (20.53°C)"
              }
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "type": "group",
      "label": {
        "en": " Time Sync (v5.5.384)",
        "fr": " Sync Heure (v5.5.384)",
        "nl": " Tijdsync (v5.5.384)",
        "de": " Zeitsync (v5.5.384)"
      },
      "children": [
        {
          "id": "time_sync_format",

            "fr": "Format Heure",
            "nl": "Tijdformaat",
            "de": "Zeitformat"
          },
          "value": "auto",
          "hint": {
            "en": "Select time sync format. Auto works for most devices. Change only if clock shows wrong time.",
            "fr": "Format de synchronisation. Auto fonctionne pour la plupart. Changer si l'heure affichée est incorrecte.",
            "nl": "Selecteer tijdsync formaat. Auto werkt voor de meeste apparaten.",

          "values": [

              "label": {
                "en": " LCD Sensor Unix (8-byte epoch 1970)",
                "fr": " Capteur LCD Unix (8 octets epoch 1970)"

            },
            {
              "id": "tuya_standard",
              "label": {
                "en": " Tuya Standard (7-byte local)",
                "fr": " Tuya Standard (7 octets local)"
              }
            },
            {

          "max": 30,

      "max": 1440,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Turn off automatically after X minutes (0 = disabled)",
        "fr": "S'éteint après X minutes (0 = désactivé)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_vacation_mode",

      }

    {
      "id": "double_click_interval",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Double Click Interval (ms)",

      "max": 1000,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Software emulation for single-action buttons",
        "fr": "Émulation logicielle pour boutons à action unique"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "overload_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Overload Protection (Watts)",
        "fr": "Protection Surcharge (Watts)"

      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 4000,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Cut power if consumption exceeds this value (0 = disabled)",
        "fr": "Coupure si la consommation dépasse cette valeur (0 = désactivé)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "inching_duration",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Inching Duration (Secs)",
        "fr": "Durée Inching (Secondes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 60,
      "step": 0.1,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Automatically turn off after X seconds (Pulse mode)",
        "fr": "S'éteint automatiquement après X secondes (mode Impulsion)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_state_recovery",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Software State Recovery",
        "fr": "Récupération d'État Logicielle"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Restore previous ON/OFF state after power failure",
        "fr": "Restore l'état précédent après une coupure de courant"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_soft_transitions",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Soft transitions (Fade)",
        "fr": "Transitions douces (Fade)"

      "value": false,
      "hint": {

        "fr": "Active les transitions douces simulées (Lumières/Variateurs)"

    {
      "id": "maintenance_threshold",

        "en": "Maintenance Alert Threshold",
        "fr": "Seuil Alerte Maintenance"

      "value": 30,

      "max": 100,

{

    "alarm_motion",
    "measure_battery",
    "measure_luminance",
    "measure_temperature",
    "measure_humidity",
    "alarm_tamper",
    "alarm_contact",
    "measure_radio_stability",
    "measure_maintenance_score"

  "energy": {
    "batteries": [
      "CR2450"
    ],

    "manufacturerName": [],
    "productId": [],

      "image": "/drivers/motion_sensor/assets/learnmode.svg",

        "en": "Press and hold the pairing button for 5 seconds until the LED flashes.",
        "fr": "Appuyez et maintenez le bouton d'appairage pendant 5 secondes jusqu'à ce que la LED clignote."
      }
    },

        "clusters": [
          0,
          61184
        ]
      }
    }
  },
  "settings": [
    {
      "id": "pir_sensitivity",

        "fr": "Sensibilité PIR",
        "nl": "PIR Gevoeligheid",
        "de": "PIR Empfindlichkeit"
      },
      "value": "1",
      "values": [
        {
          "id": "0",
          "label": {
            "en": "Low",
            "fr": "Basse",
            "nl": "Laag",
            "de": "Niedrig"
          }
        },
        {
          "id": "1",
          "label": {
            "en": "Medium",
            "fr": "Moyenne",
            "nl": "Gemiddeld",
            "de": "Mittel"
          }
        },
        {
          "id": "2",
          "label": {
            "en": "High",
            "fr": "Haute",
            "nl": "Hoog",
            "de": "Hoch"
          }
        }

      "hint": {
        "en": "PIR detection sensitivity (ZG-204ZL, TS0601 PIR sensors). Requires device wake-up.",
        "fr": "Sensibilité de détection PIR (capteurs ZG-204ZL, TS0601 PIR). Nécessite le réveil du périphérique."
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "pir_keep_time",
      "type": "dropdown",

        "fr": "Durée Maintien PIR",
        "nl": "PIR Aanhoudtijd",
        "de": "PIR Haltezeit"
      },
      "value": "0",
      "values": [
        {
          "id": "0",
          "label": {
            "en": "10 seconds",
            "fr": "10 secondes"
          }
        },
        {
          "id": "1",
          "label": {
            "en": "30 seconds",
            "fr": "30 secondes"
          }
        },
        {
          "id": "2",
          "label": {
            "en": "60 seconds",
            "fr": "60 secondes"
          }
        },
        {
          "id": "3",
          "label": {
            "en": "120 seconds",
            "fr": "120 secondes"
          }
        }
      ],

    },
    {

      "value": 60,

      "step": 10,

  "settings": [
    {
      "id": "enable_radio_sensing",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Enable Radio Presence Sensing",
        "fr": "Activer la Détection de Présence Radio"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Infer presence from Zigbee signal fluctuations (BETA)",
        "fr": "Déduit la présence des fluctuations du signal Zigbee (BETA)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "radio_sensitivity",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Radio Presence Sensitivity",
        "fr": "Sensibilité Présence Radio"
      },
      "value": 15,
      "min": 5,
      "max": 50,
      "hint": {
        "en": "LQI variance threshold (higher = less sensitive)",
        "fr": "Seuil de variance LQI (plus haut = moins sensible)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_software_child_lock",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Software Child Lock",
        "fr": "Sécurité Enfant Logicielle"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Prevents manual state changes on the device",
        "fr": "Empêche les changements d'état manuels sur l'appareil"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "auto_off_duration",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Auto-Off Timer (Minutes)",
        "fr": "Minuterie Auto-Off (Minutes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 1440,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Turn off automatically after X minutes (0 = disabled)",
        "fr": "S'éteint après X minutes (0 = désactivé)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_vacation_mode",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Vacation Mode (Presence Sim)",
        "fr": "Mode Vacances (Simulation Présence)"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Randomly toggle device during evenings to simulate presence",
        "fr": "Actionne l'appareil aléatoirement le soir pour simuler une présence"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "emulated_motion_hold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Emulated Motion Hold (Seconds)",
        "fr": "Maintien Mouvement Émulé (Secondes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 3600,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Keep motion 'ON' for X seconds after hardware clears",
        "fr": "Garde le mouvement 'ON' pendant X secondes après le reset matériel"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "double_click_interval",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Double Click Interval (ms)",
        "fr": "Intervalle Double-Clic (ms)"
      },
      "value": 400,
      "min": 100,
      "max": 1000,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Software emulation for single-action buttons",
        "fr": "Émulation logicielle pour boutons à action unique"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "overload_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Overload Protection (Watts)",
        "fr": "Protection Surcharge (Watts)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 4000,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Cut power if consumption exceeds this value (0 = disabled)",
        "fr": "Coupure si la consommation dépasse cette valeur (0 = désactivé)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "inching_duration",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Inching Duration (Secs)",
        "fr": "Durée Inching (Secondes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 60,
      "step": 0.1,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Automatically turn off after X seconds (Pulse mode)",
        "fr": "S'éteint automatiquement après X secondes (mode Impulsion)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_state_recovery",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Software State Recovery",
        "fr": "Récupération d'État Logicielle"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Restore previous ON/OFF state after power failure",
        "fr": "Restore l'état précédent après une coupure de courant"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_soft_transitions",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Soft transitions (Fade)",
        "fr": "Transitions douces (Fade)"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Enable software-simulated smooth transitions (Lights/Dim)",
        "fr": "Active les transitions douces simulées (Lumières/Variateurs)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "maintenance_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Maintenance Alert Threshold",
        "fr": "Seuil Alerte Maintenance"
      },
      "value": 30,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 100,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Alert if health score drops below this value",
        "fr": "Alerte si le score de santé descend sous cette valeur"
      }
    }
  ]
}
</file>

      }

    {
      "id": "emulated_motion_hold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Emulated Motion Hold (Seconds)",

      },

      "max": 3600,

        "fr": "Intervalle Double-Clic (ms)"

      }
    },
    {
      "id": "inching_duration",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {

        "fr": "Durée Inching (Secondes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 60,
      "step": 0.1,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Automatically turn off after X seconds (Pulse mode)",
        "fr": "S'éteint automatiquement après X secondes (mode Impulsion)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_state_recovery",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Software State Recovery",
        "fr": "Récupération d'État Logicielle"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Restore previous ON/OFF state after power failure",
        "fr": "Restore l'état précédent après une coupure de courant"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_soft_transitions",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Soft transitions (Fade)",
        "fr": "Transitions douces (Fade)"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Enable software-simulated smooth transitions (Lights/Dim)",
        "fr": "Active les transitions douces simulées (Lumières/Variateurs)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "maintenance_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Maintenance Alert Threshold",
        "fr": "Seuil Alerte Maintenance"
      },
      "value": 30,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 100,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Alert if health score drops below this value",
        "fr": "Alerte si le score de santé descend sous cette valeur"
      }
    }
  ]
}

      "image": "{{driverAssetsPath}}/icon.svg",

      }

  },
  "settings": [
    {

      "type": "dropdown",
      "label": {
        "en": "Operating Mode",
        "fr": "Mode de fonctionnement"
      },
      "hint": {
        "en": "Scene Mode allows single/double/long press. Dimmer Mode only supports single press. Auto tries to detect and switch automatically.",
        "fr": "Le mode Scène permet les appuis simples/doubles/longs. Le mode Variateur ne supporte que l'appui simple. Auto tente de détecter et basculer automatiquement."
      },
      "value": "auto",
      "values": [
        {
          "id": "auto",
          "label": {
            "en": "Auto-Detect",
            "fr": "Détection Auto"
          }
        },
        {
          "id": "scene",
          "label": {
            "en": "Scene Mode (Multi-press)",
            "fr": "Mode Scène (Multi-clics)"
          }
        },
        {
          "id": "dimmer",
          "label": {
            "en": "Dimmer Mode",
            "fr": "Mode Variateur"
          }
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_radio_sensing",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Enable Radio Presence Sensing",
        "fr": "Activer la Détection de Présence Radio"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Infer presence from Zigbee signal fluctuations (BETA)",
        "fr": "Déduit la présence des fluctuations du signal Zigbee (BETA)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "radio_sensitivity",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Radio Presence Sensitivity",
        "fr": "Sensibilité Présence Radio"
      },
      "value": 15,
      "min": 5,
      "max": 50,
      "hint": {
        "en": "LQI variance threshold (higher = less sensitive)",
        "fr": "Seuil de variance LQI (plus haut = moins sensible)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_software_child_lock",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Software Child Lock",
        "fr": "Sécurité Enfant Logicielle"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Prevents manual state changes on the device",
        "fr": "Empêche les changements d'état manuels sur l'appareil"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "auto_off_duration",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Auto-Off Timer (Minutes)",
        "fr": "Minuterie Auto-Off (Minutes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 1440,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Turn off automatically after X minutes (0 = disabled)",
        "fr": "S'éteint après X minutes (0 = désactivé)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_vacation_mode",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Vacation Mode (Presence Sim)",
        "fr": "Mode Vacances (Simulation Présence)"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Randomly toggle device during evenings to simulate presence",
        "fr": "Actionne l'appareil aléatoirement le soir pour simuler une présence"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "emulated_motion_hold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Emulated Motion Hold (Seconds)",
        "fr": "Maintien Mouvement Émulé (Secondes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 3600,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Keep motion 'ON' for X seconds after hardware clears",
        "fr": "Garde le mouvement 'ON' pendant X secondes après le reset matériel"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "double_click_interval",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Double Click Interval (ms)",
        "fr": "Intervalle Double-Clic (ms)"
      },
      "value": 400,
      "min": 100,
      "max": 1000,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Software emulation for single-action buttons",
        "fr": "Émulation logicielle pour boutons à action unique"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "overload_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Overload Protection (Watts)",
        "fr": "Protection Surcharge (Watts)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 4000,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Cut power if consumption exceeds this value (0 = disabled)",
        "fr": "Coupure si la consommation dépasse cette valeur (0 = désactivé)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "inching_duration",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Inching Duration (Secs)",
        "fr": "Durée Inching (Secondes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 60,
      "step": 0.1,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Automatically turn off after X seconds (Pulse mode)",
        "fr": "S'éteint automatiquement après X secondes (mode Impulsion)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_state_recovery",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Software State Recovery",
        "fr": "Récupération d'État Logicielle"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Restore previous ON/OFF state after power failure",
        "fr": "Restore l'état précédent après une coupure de courant"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_soft_transitions",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Soft transitions (Fade)",
        "fr": "Transitions douces (Fade)"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Enable software-simulated smooth transitions (Lights/Dim)",
        "fr": "Active les transitions douces simulées (Lumières/Variateurs)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "maintenance_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Maintenance Alert Threshold",
        "fr": "Seuil Alerte Maintenance"
      },
      "value": 30,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 100,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Alert if health score drops below this value",
        "fr": "Alerte si le score de santé descend sous cette valeur"
      }
    }
  ],
  "maintenanceActions": [
    {
      "id": "ota_check",
      "title": {
        "en": "Check Zigbee OTA Update",
        "fr": "Vérifier MàJ OTA",
        "nl": "Controleer op OTA-updates"
      }
    }
  ],
  "flow": {
    "triggers": [],
    "conditions": [],
    "actions": []
  }
}
</file>

    {

        "en": "Operating Mode",
        "fr": "Mode de fonctionnement"
      },
      "hint": {
        "en": "Scene Mode allows single/double/long press. Dimmer Mode only supports single press. Auto tries to detect and switch automatically.",
        "fr": "Le mode Scène permet les appuis simples/doubles/longs. Le mode Variateur ne supporte que l'appui simple. Auto tente de détecter et basculer automatiquement."
      },
      "value": "auto",
      "values": [
        {
          "id": "auto",
          "label": {
            "en": "Auto-Detect",
            "fr": "Détection Auto"
          }
        },
        {
          "id": "scene",
          "label": {
            "en": "Scene Mode (Multi-press)",
            "fr": "Mode Scène (Multi-clics)"
          }
        },
        {
          "id": "dimmer",
          "label": {
            "en": "Dimmer Mode",
            "fr": "Mode Variateur"
          }
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_radio_sensing",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Enable Radio Presence Sensing",
        "fr": "Activer la Détection de Présence Radio"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Infer presence from Zigbee signal fluctuations (BETA)",
        "fr": "Déduit la présence des fluctuations du signal Zigbee (BETA)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "radio_sensitivity",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Radio Presence Sensitivity",
        "fr": "Sensibilité Présence Radio"
      },
      "value": 15,
      "min": 5,
      "max": 50,
      "hint": {
        "en": "LQI variance threshold (higher = less sensitive)",
        "fr": "Seuil de variance LQI (plus haut = moins sensible)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_software_child_lock",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Software Child Lock",
        "fr": "Sécurité Enfant Logicielle"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Prevents manual state changes on the device",
        "fr": "Empêche les changements d'état manuels sur l'appareil"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "auto_off_duration",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Auto-Off Timer (Minutes)",
        "fr": "Minuterie Auto-Off (Minutes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 1440,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Turn off automatically after X minutes (0 = disabled)",
        "fr": "S'éteint après X minutes (0 = désactivé)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_vacation_mode",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Vacation Mode (Presence Sim)",
        "fr": "Mode Vacances (Simulation Présence)"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Randomly toggle device during evenings to simulate presence",
        "fr": "Actionne l'appareil aléatoirement le soir pour simuler une présence"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "emulated_motion_hold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Emulated Motion Hold (Seconds)",
        "fr": "Maintien Mouvement Émulé (Secondes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 3600,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Keep motion 'ON' for X seconds after hardware clears",
        "fr": "Garde le mouvement 'ON' pendant X secondes après le reset matériel"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "double_click_interval",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Double Click Interval (ms)",
        "fr": "Intervalle Double-Clic (ms)"
      },
      "value": 400,
      "min": 100,
      "max": 1000,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Software emulation for single-action buttons",
        "fr": "Émulation logicielle pour boutons à action unique"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "overload_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Overload Protection (Watts)",
        "fr": "Protection Surcharge (Watts)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 4000,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Cut power if consumption exceeds this value (0 = disabled)",
        "fr": "Coupure si la consommation dépasse cette valeur (0 = désactivé)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "inching_duration",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Inching Duration (Secs)",
        "fr": "Durée Inching (Secondes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 60,
      "step": 0.1,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Automatically turn off after X seconds (Pulse mode)",
        "fr": "S'éteint automatiquement après X secondes (mode Impulsion)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_state_recovery",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Software State Recovery",
        "fr": "Récupération d'État Logicielle"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Restore previous ON/OFF state after power failure",
        "fr": "Restore l'état précédent après une coupure de courant"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_soft_transitions",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Soft transitions (Fade)",
        "fr": "Transitions douces (Fade)"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Enable software-simulated smooth transitions (Lights/Dim)",
        "fr": "Active les transitions douces simulées (Lumières/Variateurs)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "maintenance_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Maintenance Alert Threshold",
        "fr": "Seuil Alerte Maintenance"
      },
      "value": 30,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 100,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Alert if health score drops below this value",
        "fr": "Alerte si le score de santé descend sous cette valeur"
      }
    }
  ],
  "maintenanceActions": [
    {
      "id": "ota_check",
      "title": {
        "en": "Check Zigbee OTA Update",
        "fr": "Vérifier MàJ OTA",
        "nl": "Controleer op OTA-updates"
      }
    }
  ],
  "capabilitiesOptions": {
    "button.1": {
      "title": {
        "en": "Button 1",
        "fr": "Bouton 1",
        "nl": "Knop 1",
        "de": "Taste 1"
      }
    },
    "button.2": {
      "title": {
        "en": "Button 2",
        "fr": "Bouton 2",
        "nl": "Knop 2",
        "de": "Taste 2"
      }
    },
    "button.3": {
      "title": {
        "en": "Button 3",
        "fr": "Bouton 3",
        "nl": "Knop 3",
        "de": "Taste 3"
      }
    },
    "button.4": {
      "title": {
        "en": "Button 4",
        "fr": "Bouton 4",
        "nl": "Knop 4",
        "de": "Taste 4"
      }
    },
    "measure_battery": {
      "title": {
        "en": "Battery",
        "fr": "Batterie",
        "nl": "Batterij",
        "de": "Batterie"
      }
    }
  },
  "flow": {
    "triggers": [],
    "conditions": [],
    "actions": []
  }
}

      },
      "value": true,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Estimate power consumption when real measurement is not available (AC/DC devices only)",
        "fr": "Estimer la consommation quand la mesure réelle n'est pas disponible (appareils AC/DC seulement)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "invert_alarm",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": " Invert Water Alarm",
        "fr": " Inverser Alarme Eau",
        "nl": " Inverteer Wateralarm",
        "de": " Wasseralarm Invertieren"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Enable if water detection shows opposite state (wet=dry, dry=wet). Lasse_K forum fix.",
        "fr": "Activer si la détection d'eau affiche l'état inverse (mouillé=sec, sec=mouillé)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_radio_sensing",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Enable Radio Presence Sensing",
        "fr": "Activer la Détection de Présence Radio"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Infer presence from Zigbee signal fluctuations (BETA)",
        "fr": "Déduit la présence des fluctuations du signal Zigbee (BETA)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "radio_sensitivity",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Radio Presence Sensitivity",
        "fr": "Sensibilité Présence Radio"
      },
      "value": 15,
      "min": 5,
      "max": 50,
      "hint": {
        "en": "LQI variance threshold (higher = less sensitive)",
        "fr": "Seuil de variance LQI (plus haut = moins sensible)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_software_child_lock",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Software Child Lock",
        "fr": "Sécurité Enfant Logicielle"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Prevents manual state changes on the device",
        "fr": "Empêche les changements d'état manuels sur l'appareil"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "auto_off_duration",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Auto-Off Timer (Minutes)",
        "fr": "Minuterie Auto-Off (Minutes)"

      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 1440,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Turn off automatically after X minutes (0 = disabled)",
        "fr": "S'éteint après X minutes (0 = désactivé)"
      }

    {
      "id": "enable_vacation_mode",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Vacation Mode (Presence Sim)",
        "fr": "Mode Vacances (Simulation Présence)"
      },
      "value": false,

        "en": "Randomly toggle device during evenings to simulate presence",
        "fr": "Actionne l'appareil aléatoirement le soir pour simuler une présence"

    {
      "id": "emulated_motion_hold",

      "min": 0,
      "max": 3600,

        "en": "Keep motion 'ON' for X seconds after hardware clears",
        "fr": "Garde le mouvement 'ON' pendant X secondes après le reset matériel"
      }
    },
    {

      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Double Click Interval (ms)",
        "fr": "Intervalle Double-Clic (ms)"
      },

      "min": 100,
      "max": 1000,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Software emulation for single-action buttons",
        "fr": "Émulation logicielle pour boutons à action unique"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "overload_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Overload Protection (Watts)",
        "fr": "Protection Surcharge (Watts)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 4000,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Cut power if consumption exceeds this value (0 = disabled)",
        "fr": "Coupure si la consommation dépasse cette valeur (0 = désactivé)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "inching_duration",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Inching Duration (Secs)",
        "fr": "Durée Inching (Secondes)"
      },
      "value": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 60,
      "step": 0.1,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Automatically turn off after X seconds (Pulse mode)",
        "fr": "S'éteint automatiquement après X secondes (mode Impulsion)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_state_recovery",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Software State Recovery",
        "fr": "Récupération d'État Logicielle"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Restore previous ON/OFF state after power failure",
        "fr": "Restore l'état précédent après une coupure de courant"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "enable_soft_transitions",

      "label": {
        "en": "Soft transitions (Fade)",
        "fr": "Transitions douces (Fade)"
      },
      "value": false,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Enable software-simulated smooth transitions (Lights/Dim)",
        "fr": "Active les transitions douces simulées (Lumières/Variateurs)"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "maintenance_threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "label": {
        "en": "Maintenance Alert Threshold",
        "fr": "Seuil Alerte Maintenance"
      },
      "value": 30,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 100,
      "hint": {
        "en": "Alert if health score drops below this value",
        "fr": "Alerte si le score de santé descend sous cette valeur"
      }
    }

    "large": "drivers/water_leak_sensor/assets/images/large.png",

  ],

        "en": "Automatically turn off after X seconds (Pulse mode)",

    },
    {
      "id": "enable_state_recovery",
      "type": "checkbox",
      "label": {
        "en": "Software State Recovery",
        "fr": "Récupération d'État Logicielle"
      },
      "value": false,
